entities.summary: Ferdinando Arborio Gattinara di Breme, Duc de Sartirana Lomellina, marquis de Breme was an Italian naturalist and entomologist who specialised in Coleoptera and Diptera. He was a "sénateur" of the Société entomologique de France and president of that society in 1844.
